verdict.rationale: GPU-fallback diagnostics are a fair question for an inference engine with multiple GPU backends, so the axis applies. The evidence shows llama.cpp has CUDA/HIP/MUSA and Metal acceleration plus CPU+GPU hybrid offload, but nothing shows it reports why GPU initialization failed or warns when it silently falls back to CPU. One community comment about a 40-layer GPU offload limit describes a limitation, not diagnostic output.
